name: Residual Boundary Algebra completion space

semantics: exact strong state and action value
best move derived by exact argmax

fixed_structure.statement: Preserve standard rules, geometry, legality, gravity, turn parity, terminal behavior, first-win stopping, and applicable authority-1.1 structural facts.
Every admissible completion determines exact ordinary strong state/action value and the exact best-move set on every legal in-scope state.

Current research exposes support, support-local residual shapes, player-labelled residual completion functions, legal one-cell cofactor transition, and strong-score threshold regions; this factorization is not asserted minimal or canonical.

Ordinary value/future-behavior identity remains separate from physical/history/proof identity; empirical support remains separate from theorem authority; candidate relations remain separate from IsoGraph relation edges.

open_region.question: What is the smallest exact generating set of operations/relations from which complete RBA value semantics follow?
What structural parameter controls exact RBA boundary/intermediate size toward the empty root?
Can rank-wise propagation be exactly composed/eliminated by idempotence, bounded index, nilpotence, transfer composition, exponentiation, or another law?
Is there an exact finite expression/operator composition from empty-board structure directly to action values/best move without explicit rank iteration?
Is the support-local residual-shape lattice minimal for ordinary exact value, or does a strictly coarser exact observation exist?
What exact relationship, if any, connects RBA ordinary-value structure to the clause/proof carrier and C4-R0043/C4-R0069/C4-R0076?
Which RBA laws generalize to fixed-K variable boards or arbitrary finite gravity Connect-K, and with what complexity bounds?
Are current residual/upset/Upper-Lower/blocker factorizations canonical, merely lawful alternatives, or reducible to a smaller equivalent structure?

possibility_universe.statement: All algebraic completions/factorizations of the current RBA research information state that preserve the declared standard-7x6 ordinary-value meaning, fixed authority facts, constraints, interfaces and exclusions, and return exact strong state/action value for every legal in-scope state.
allows: conservative abstract residual superdomains with exact restriction to legal states
alternate lawful factorizations under qualified bridges
different evaluation schedules for the same algebra
excludes: heuristics or approximations represented as exact RBA
solver brand or execution schedule as unproved semantic primitive

constraints.statement: V_RBA and Q_RBA equal exact ordinary legal strong state/action value throughout scope.
Legal action landing events, terminal tokens and nonterminal structural transitions preserve exact ordinary future-value meaning.
Post-terminal hypothetical distinctions cannot affect ordinary value.
If an abstract superdomain is used, unrealizable abstract states cannot create false value claims on legal states.
Ordinary-value equivalence does not authorize proof/certificate/history/advisory identity.
Solved labels and finite outcome samples are falsification/qualification evidence, not theorem premises.
Post-1.1 claim correspondences remain claim metadata until independently deductive or guarded-exact.
A mismatch updates evidence/constraints before any narrowing of the possibility universe.

interfaces.input: Only profile-authorized structural facts and pinned exact derived relations; no hidden history, solved outcomes or unproved relation topology.
interfaces.output: support + legal action + exact strong-score/threshold semantics -> exact action value -> exact best-move set by argmax
interfaces.proof_side: Proof/certificate artifacts remain separate unless a qualified bridge establishes the required correspondence.

closure_authority: post-1.1 research artifacts at their recorded epistemic statuses

realization_family.statement: The family of algebraic completions still permitted by the fixed structure, possibility universe, constraints, interfaces, exclusions and pinned revision evidence.
realization_family.note: OPEN does not make every proposition semantic UNRESOLVED; proposition-specific QU witness/coverage burdens remain.

exclusions: direct optimal-action predicate as an upward-closed RBA frontier
cross-support raw residual dominance without stronger guards
abstract residual pairs called legal q without proof
owner-bit BDD or line-hit/history state assumed canonical merely because exact
distributed universal proof Cartesian products assumed necessary for ordinary value
solved database labels as theorem premises
proof/certificate identity collapsed to ordinary q/value identity
C4-R0043/C4-R0069/C4-R0076 correspondences consumed as established edges without proof
standard 7x6 root claimed solved by RBA

claims.proposition: Every admissible RBA realization returns exact ordinary legal strong state/action value.
Every admissible RBA realization preserves first-win stopping.
No admissible RBA realization may use proof/certificate identity collapse or solved labels as hidden semantic premises.
RBA admits an exact rank-free/direct-root formulation.
RBA boundaries/intermediates remain compact to the empty root under a useful bound.
Residual-shape lattice plus adjoint/duality operators is a minimal complete RBA basis.
RBA ordinary-value closure discharges the ordinary-value portion of C4-R0076.

resource_completeness.warning: Research/computation incompleteness is not semantic QU UNRESOLVED.

refinement_rule: Refine only when qualified information narrows R(RBA) without changing the declared subject/meaning; incompatible target/scope changes are revisions.
discovery_targets: transfer/semiring algebras with bounded iteration index

topology_placement.primary_chain: residual/future-behavior region -> OPEN RBA-REL-01 -> RBA -> OPEN RBA-REL-02 -> exact ordinary value-boundary region
